SELECT A.ACTL_FX_REFNO, -- ref번호(확인용) A.FX_REFNO_SRNO, -- ref번호(확인용) A.INPT_MST_SRNO, -- 마스터번호(확인용) B.INPT_TASK_ID, -- 이미지아이디 A.AI_INPT_CMN_CD AS INPT_SANCTION_NO, -- 심사번호 A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, -- 그룹번호 NVL(B.IMEX_HIS_CD, A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO) AS IMEX_HIS_CD, -- 항목코드 B.IMEX_HIS_SRNO, -- 항목코드 ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DAT) > 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM ( SELECT SD.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT DAT, COUNT(SD.INPT_SANCTION_NO) SANC_CNT FROM CSPD001TM SA, CSPD002TG SB, CSPD004TF SD WHERE SA.INPT_MST_SRNO = SB.INPT_MST_SRNO AND SA.INPT_MST_SRNO = SD.INPT_MST_SRNO AND SB.INPT_TASK_ID = SD.INPT_TASK_ID AND SB.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND SD.INPT_SANCTION_NO = B.INPT_SANCTION_NO AND SB.INPT_BL_GRP_NO = B.INPT_BL_GRP_NO GROUP BY SD.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT ) ) AS ITM_INPT_NACRD_YN, -- 불일치여부 B.ITM_INPT_RVSN_YN, ( DECODE(A.AI_INPT_CMN_CD, '999', DECODE(A.AI_INPT_APPV_STCD, '160', '1', '140', '3', '2'), '50', NVL2(B.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT, NVL(SUBSTR(B.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, 0, 20), SUBSTR(B.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT, 0, 20)) , A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO) , NVL(B.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, B.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT)) ) AS INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT, -- 심사데이터 B.BFRS_AICR_EXTC_TXT, B.BFRS_TA_EXTC_TXT, B.AFRS_AICR_EXTC_TXT, B.AFRS_TA_EXTC_TXT, B.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, -- 수기입력 B.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN, B.ITM_INPT_XAXIS_STA_CRDN_CN, B.ITM_INPT_XAXIS_END_CRDN_CN, B.ITM_INPT_YAXIS_STA_CRDN_CN, B.ITM_INPT_YAXIS_END_CRDN_CN, B.AI_INPT_ALT_YN, -- 경고여부 B.AI_INPT_SANCTION_RULE_TXT, -- 심사규칙 B.AI_INPT_WORD_ACRD_RT, B.AI_INPT_EXTC_SNTN_TXT, -- TA전처리후 B.TRN_LOG_SRNO, B.LST_DB_CHG_ID, B.LST_DB_CHG_DTM, A.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM -- 심사명
FROM ( -- 업무구분별 항목 테이블 SELECT C.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, C.INPT_MST_SRNO, A.ACTL_FX_REFNO, A.FX_REFNO_SRNO, B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD, B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM, B.AI_INPT_SORT_SEQ, A.AI_INPT_APPV_STCD FROM CSPD001TM A, CSPD112TI B, ( SELECT DISTINCT INPT_MST_SRNO, INPT_BL_GRP_NO FROM CSPD002TG ) C WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = C.INPT_MST_SRNO AND A.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND B.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = DECODE(A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, '1', '265', '2', '255', '') ) A, ( SELECT TO_CHAR(B.INPT_MST_SRNO) INPT_MST_SRNO, A.ACTL_FX_REFNO, B.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, B.IMEX_HIS_CD, B.IMEX_HIS_SRNO, B.AI_INPT_PAPS_QLT_SCRE, B.INPT_TASK_ID, C.ITM_INPT_RVSN_YN, C.INPT_SANCTION_NO, C.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT, C.AI_INPT_SANCTION_RULE_TXT, C.BFRS_AICR_EXTC_TXT, C.BFRS_TA_EXTC_TXT, C.AFRS_AICR_EXTC_TXT, C.AFRS_TA_EXTC_TXT, C.AI_INPT_EXTC_SNTN_TXT, C.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, C.AI_INPT_ALT_YN, C.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN, C.ITM_INPT_XAXIS_STA_CRDN_CN, C.ITM_INPT_XAXIS_END_CRDN_CN, C.ITM_INPT_YAXIS_STA_CRDN_CN, C.ITM_INPT_YAXIS_END_CRDN_CN, C.TRN_LOG_SRNO, C.LST_DB_CHG_ID, C.LST_DB_CHG_DTM, C.AI_INPT_WORD_ACRD_RT FROM CSPD001TM A, -- 마스터 테이블 CSPD002TG B, -- 이미지 테이블 CSPD004TF C -- 심사상세 테이블 WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = B.INPT_MST_SRNO AND A.INPT_MST_SRNO = C.INPT_MST_SRNO AND B.INPT_TASK_ID = C.INPT_TASK_ID AND B.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND C.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY B.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, B.AI_INPT_PAPS_QLT_SCRE DESC ) B WHERE A.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = TO_CHAR(B.INPT_SANCTION_NO(+)) AND A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO = B.INPT_BL_GRP_NO(+) ORDER BY A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, INPT_SANCTION_NO

SELECT A.ACTL_FX_REFNO, -- ref번호(확인용) A.FX_REFNO_SRNO, -- ref번호(확인용) A.INPT_MST_SRNO, -- 마스터번호(확인용) B.INPT_TASK_ID, -- 이미지아이디 A.AI_INPT_CMN_CD AS INPT_SANCTION_NO, -- 심사번호 A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, -- 그룹번호 NVL(B.IMEX_HIS_CD, A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO) AS IMEX_HIS_CD, -- 항목코드 B.IMEX_HIS_SRNO, -- 항목코드 ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DAT) > 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM ( SELECT SD.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT DAT, COUNT(SD.INPT_SANCTION_NO) SANC_CNT FROM CSPD001TM SA, CSPD002TG SB, CSPD004TF SD WHERE SA.INPT_MST_SRNO = SB.INPT_MST_SRNO AND SA.INPT_MST_SRNO = SD.INPT_MST_SRNO AND SB.INPT_TASK_ID = SD.INPT_TASK_ID AND SB.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND SD.INPT_SANCTION_NO = B.INPT_SANCTION_NO AND SB.INPT_BL_GRP_NO = B.INPT_BL_GRP_NO GROUP BY SD.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT ) ) AS ITM_INPT_NACRD_YN, -- 불일치여부 B.ITM_INPT_RVSN_YN, ( DECODE(A.AI_INPT_CMN_CD, '999', DECODE(A.AI_INPT_APPV_STCD, '160', '1', '140', '3', '2'), '50', NVL2(B.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT, NVL(SUBSTR(B.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, 0, 20), SUBSTR(B.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT, 0, 20)) , A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO) , NVL(B.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, B.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT)) ) AS INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT, -- 심사데이터 B.BFRS_AICR_EXTC_TXT, B.BFRS_TA_EXTC_TXT, B.AFRS_AICR_EXTC_TXT, B.AFRS_TA_EXTC_TXT, B.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, -- 수기입력 B.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN, B.ITM_INPT_XAXIS_STA_CRDN_CN, B.ITM_INPT_XAXIS_END_CRDN_CN, B.ITM_INPT_YAXIS_STA_CRDN_CN, B.ITM_INPT_YAXIS_END_CRDN_CN, B.AI_INPT_ALT_YN, -- 경고여부 B.AI_INPT_SANCTION_RULE_TXT, -- 심사규칙 B.AI_INPT_WORD_ACRD_RT, B.AI_INPT_EXTC_SNTN_TXT, -- TA전처리후 B.TRN_LOG_SRNO, B.LST_DB_CHG_ID, B.LST_DB_CHG_DTM, A.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM -- 심사명
FROM ( -- 업무구분별 항목 테이블 SELECT C.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, C.INPT_MST_SRNO, A.ACTL_FX_REFNO, A.FX_REFNO_SRNO, B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD, B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM, B.AI_INPT_SORT_SEQ, A.AI_INPT_APPV_STCD FROM CSPD001TM A, CSPD112TI B, ( SELECT DISTINCT INPT_MST_SRNO, INPT_BL_GRP_NO FROM CSPD002TG ) C WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = C.INPT_MST_SRNO AND A.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND B.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = DECODE(A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, '1', '240', '2', '230', '') ) A, ( SELECT TO_CHAR(B.INPT_MST_SRNO) INPT_MST_SRNO, A.ACTL_FX_REFNO, B.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, B.IMEX_HIS_CD, B.IMEX_HIS_SRNO, B.AI_INPT_PAPS_QLT_SCRE, B.INPT_TASK_ID, C.ITM_INPT_RVSN_YN, FN_ITM_ORDER(C.INPT_SANCTION_NO, B.IMEX_HIS_CD) RNK, C.INPT_SANCTION_NO, C.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT, C.AI_INPT_SANCTION_RULE_TXT, C.BFRS_AICR_EXTC_TXT, C.BFRS_TA_EXTC_TXT, C.AFRS_AICR_EXTC_TXT, C.AFRS_TA_EXTC_TXT, C.AI_INPT_EXTC_SNTN_TXT, C.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, C.AI_INPT_ALT_YN, C.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN, C.ITM_INPT_XAXIS_STA_CRDN_CN, C.ITM_INPT_XAXIS_END_CRDN_CN, C.ITM_INPT_YAXIS_STA_CRDN_CN, C.ITM_INPT_YAXIS_END_CRDN_CN, C.TRN_LOG_SRNO, C.LST_DB_CHG_ID, C.LST_DB_CHG_DTM, C.AI_INPT_WORD_ACRD_RT FROM CSPD001TM A, -- 마스터 테이블 CSPD002TG B, -- 이미지 테이블 CSPD004TF C -- 심사상세 테이블 WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = B.INPT_MST_SRNO AND A.INPT_MST_SRNO = C.INPT_MST_SRNO AND B.INPT_TASK_ID = C.INPT_TASK_ID AND B.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND C.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY B.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, B.AI_INPT_PAPS_QLT_SCRE DESC ) B WHERE A.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = TO_CHAR(B.INPT_SANCTION_NO(+)) AND A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO = B.INPT_BL_GRP_NO(+) ORDER BY A.INPT_BL_GRP_NO, A.AI_INPT_SORT_SEQ
